# Changelog

## 0.1.0-alpha.3 — 2026-07-24 (pre-public correction 2026-07-29)

- Added typed State–Decision–Effect and Review Assurance dispatch, mappings, schemas, fixtures, OMP surfaces, migration guidance, and release qualification while preserving alpha.2 procedures and legacy interfaces.
- Corrected current-facing package, README, installation, limitation, and OMP metadata before the first public tag; historical predecessor records remain unchanged.
- Clarified that legacy `bbk_version: 0.1.0-alpha.4` projection fields identify the structure/slice contract dialect rather than the installed core version or compatibility minimum.
- Consolidated release-numbered OMP-context tests into responsibility-oriented dispatch/runtime suites and enforced explicit UTF-8 text I/O in Python tools and tests.
- Replaced the alpha.4-only structure-validator check with capability-aware compatibility handling that accepts alpha.4, alpha.8, alpha.11.x, compatible future alphas, and stable successors while rejecting genuinely older cores.
- Renamed the gate requirement from `bbk-alpha4-structure-validator` to the version-neutral `bbk-structure-contract-validator`.

## 0.1.0-alpha.2 — 2026-07-23

- Require BBK `0.1.0-alpha.4`.
- Declare supported `implementation_structure` capability.
- Add `structure`, `slice`, and `structure-review` entrypoints.
- Add four required namespaced alpha.4 output schemas plus an actual-inventory schema.
- Add `python-implementation-structure-authoring`, `python-execution-slice-design`, and `python-implementation-structure-review` skills.
- Update router, comprehensive survey, API/package, runtime, typing, test, and evidence guidance for generic contracts, slices, fixed decisions, delegated freedom, and planned/actual comparison.
- Add `implementation-structure` and `execution-slicing` task mappings.
- Add deterministic structure, state-ownership, slice-touchpoint, scaffolding, and planned/actual gate recipes.
- Add Python alpha.4 fixtures for routine private work, public typed APIs, runtime validation, asyncio cancellation, multiprocessing, plugins, packages, migrations, unsupported subjects, foundation exceptions, harmless private divergence, public import drift, and ownership drift.
- Add six OMP tools and six commands total.
- Correct forced-upgrade backup path normalization so replacements are copied beneath the owned backup root instead of aliasing the live destination.
- Preserve alpha.1 behavior and immutable source provenance.

## 0.1.0-alpha.1 — 2026-07-23

Initial comprehensive-alpha Python profile with static preflight, proportional resolution, gate planning, focused review packs, installer, OMP extension, and reproducible package qualification.
